description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Quick Cast 2]/[Quick Cast 3] to all allies if 0-3/4+ FF5 allies are alive, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Veteran's Resolve Mode] to the user if 4+ FF5 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Veteran's Resolve Mode
description.text: Casts Dawn Onslaught 1 after using Indomitable Strike, casts Dawn Onslaught 2 after using Immortal Strike, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
